_source: Core Rulebook, Cleric: Domains (d20pfsrd.com/classes/core-classes/cleric/domains/paizo-domains). The numbers are the ones content/domains/powers.json already carries for these powers; this file adds what using one DOES. A druid with the domain through nature bond uses her druid level (Core Rulebook, Nature Bond).
_grammar: rules/class_abilities.py, module docstring. `power` is the key in content/domains/powers.json; a character has the ability exactly when `domains.powers_had` lists that power, and spends the pool that file already defines.

abilities.name: Lightning Arc
abilities.source: Air domain: a standard action, a ranged touch attack at a foe within 30 ft, 1d6 electricity + 1 per two cleric levels; 3 + Wis times a day.
abilities.text: Ranged touch, 30 ft: 1d6 electricity + 1 per two levels.

abilities.text: Ranged touch, 30 ft: 1d6 acid + 1 per two levels.

abilities.source: Weather domain: a standard action, a ranged touch attack at a foe within 30 ft, 1d6 nonlethal + 1 per two cleric levels, and the target takes -2 on attack rolls for 1 round; 3 + Wis times a day.

abilities.tell: {name} calls a burst of wind and rain down on {target}.

abilities.name: Wooden Fist
abilities.source: Plant domain: a free action, for 3 + Wis rounds a day: unarmed strikes deal lethal damage, provoke no attack of opportunity, and add +1 per two cleric levels (minimum +1) to damage.
abilities.text: Fists hard as wood: + half your level to unarmed damage (min +1), a round a round.
not_yet: Lethal unarmed damage without the -4, and no attack of opportunity for striking unarmed: neither rides the stance yet.

abilities.name: Artificer's Touch
abilities.source: Artifice domain (d20pfsrd, read 2026-10-05): "you can cause damage to objects and construct creatures by striking them with a melee touch attack. Objects and constructs take 1d6 points of damage +1 for every two cleric levels you possess. This attack bypasses an amount of damage reduction and hardness equal to your cleric level." 3 + Wis times a day.
abilities.text: Melee touch, constructs only: 1d6 + 1 per two levels, passing DR up to your level.
abilities.tell: {name} strikes {target} with a hand that knows how it was made.
not_yet: Objects: a struck object and its hardness have no hit points in the scene yet, so only constructs are touched.
Mending at will: the cantrip is the cast door's, not this one.

abilities.name: Rebuke Death
abilities.source: Healing domain: touch a living creature below 0 hit points: heal 1d4 + 1 per two cleric levels; 3 + Wis times a day.
abilities.text: Touch the dying: heal 1d4 + 1 per two levels.
abilities.tell: {name} lays a hand on {target} and rebukes death.

abilities.name: Calming Touch
abilities.source: Community domain: touch a creature: it heals 1d6 + your cleric level in nonlethal damage, and is no longer fatigued, shaken or sickened (exhausted creatures are not helped); 3 + Wis times a day.
abilities.text: Touch: heal 1d6 + your level in non-lethal damage, and lift fatigued, shaken and sickened.

abilities.name: Destructive Smite
abilities.source: Destruction domain: declared before a single melee attack: + half your cleric level (minimum +1) as a morale bonus on its damage; 3 + Wis times a day.
abilities.text: Your next melee attack this round: + half your level (min +1) morale damage.
abilities.tell: {name} gathers destruction into the next blow.
